title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Infrastructure
text:
Founded in 2015, Shield AI is a venture-backed deep-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include the V-BAT aircraft, Hivemind Enterprise, and the Hivemind Vision product lines. With nine offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit Shield http://www.shield.ai/ Open . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.




JOB DESCRIPTION

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Manager, Manufacturing Infrastructure to lead the server and network infrastructure for our new 400,000 sq ft manufacturing facility in the Seattle-Tacoma area, home to our newest flagship product. You will own the systems and network engineering that keep the factory running, from build-out and commissioning through ramp to high-rate production, including compute, virtualization, storage, backup and recovery, IT and OT networks, wireless, and the infrastructure behind manufacturing systems such as MES and PLM. You will lead a site-based team of systems and network engineers and partner closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Operations, Facilities, Cybersecurity, Cloud Platform, Network Engineering, and Service Delivery.

This position is based on site in the Seattle, Tacoma, or surrounding SeaTac, WA area.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the infrastructure strategy, architecture, roadmap, and budget for the manufacturing facility.

 - Lead technology readiness for the facility from design through construction, commissioning, and production ramp, working with Facilities, contractors, and Manufacturing Engineering.

 - Build, lead, and develop an on-site team of systems and network engineers, including hiring, on-call coverage, and performance management.

 - Own design and operation of the factory network, including core, access, wireless, IT/OT segmentation, and connectivity to Shield AI sites and cloud, in partnership with Network Engineering.

 - Own server, virtualization, storage, backup, and disaster recovery infrastructure for manufacturing systems such as MES, ERP and PLM integrations (including Teamcenter), quality, and test systems.

 - Provide management oversight for the servers, virtualization, storage, and network infrastructure that host and connect production systems and test and inspection equipment, partnering with Manufacturing Engineering, controls teams, and equipment vendors.

 - Oversee site data center, MDF/IDF, and server room infrastructure, including capacity, power and cooling, cabling, and documentation, in coordination with Facilities.

 - Partner with Cybersecurity to apply segmentation, patching, vulnerability management, and access controls aligned with NIST 800-171, CMMC, and ITAR requirements.

 - Define uptime targets, change governance, and maintenance windows that fit production schedules; lead major incident response and root-cause analysis.

 - Drive standardization, automation, and observability, and build repeatable site blueprints for future lines and facilities.

 - Manage vendors, integrators, contracts, and budgets, and communicate site readiness, risks, and status to technical and executive stakeholders.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 10+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure, network, or systems engineering, including 5+ years leading engineers, with direct experience supporting a manufacturing or production environment.

 - Experience standing up or significantly expanding infrastructure for a new or large facility, from design through operations.

 - Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, including switching, routing, wireless, segmentation, firewalls, and WAN connectivity.

 - Experience designing and operating compute, virtualization, storage, backup, disaster recovery, and Windows and Linux server environments.

 - Experience supporting manufacturing systems such as MES, ERP, PLM, or quality platforms, and familiarity with how production equipment connects to the network.

 - Strong understanding of high availability, capacity planning, patching, and monitoring in an environment where downtime affects output.

 - Strong people leadership skills, including hiring, coaching, and developing technical talent.

 - Experience managing vendors, budgets, and capital projects, with clear written and verbal communication.

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

 - Ability to participate in after-hours work and travel periodically to other Shield AI locations.

 - This position may require access to export-controlled information, and employment may be contingent on U.S. person status or export authorization.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience in aerospace, defense, or other regulated manufacturing, including ITAR and CUI environments.

 - Experience with high-rate production ramp and Siemens Teamcenter or other MES platforms.

 - Experience with VMware, Hyper-V, NetApp, Cohesity, Active Directory, and Entra ID.

 - Experience with automation and infrastructure as code (PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Terraform).

 - Familiarity with OT security guidance such as IEC 62443 and industrial protocols such as OPC UA.

 - Relevant networking, security, or infrastructure certifications (for example CCNP, CISSP, or ITIL).
